plugin.name: wayfire-slide-peek
plugin._long: Slide the foreground (windows and panel) off one screen edge while the lumen-drawer grid slides in from the opposite edge, over the stationary wallpaper.

option.name: direction
option._long: Which edge the desktop grid enters from. "top" slides the grid down from the top while the foreground exits off the bottom; "bottom" slides it up from the bottom while the foreground exits off the top.

option.name: drawer_app_id
option._long: App-id (layer-shell namespace) of the desktop grid surface. It is kept hidden while the slide is closed and revealed only while it is open.

option.name: widget_app_id
option._long: App-id (layer-shell namespace) of the desktop widget layer. It shares the BOTTOM layer with the app drawer, so it is hidden for the duration of a reveal and restored when the reveal closes.
